context_manifest.patch_state: uncommitted working tree changes prepared for independent EvidenceGate review

migrations: Added provider-neutral planner request/result contracts, artifact records, budget limits, replan trigger vocabulary, and validation result objects.
Added AcceptancePlanner, ExecutionPlanner, and RepairPlanner ports without changing SchedulerPort; Scheduler still accepts only trusted PlanIR.
Added PlannerContextBuilder, deterministic planner artifact creation, read-only planner runtime profile enforcement, fixture planners, AgentDriver planner adapters, and PlannerOutputValidator.
Extended PlanPatchDraft and plan-patch schema with reusedEvidenceRefs so repair plans can preserve unchanged node and Evidence references.
Allowed CodexSDKDriver to pass through PlanDraft, PlanPatchDraft, and AcceptanceDraft after explicit output contract validation.
Added focused tests covering all TASK-0030 acceptance criteria and added new core modules to adapter dependency lint.

acceptance_map.criterion: Planner roles receive read-only runtime profiles and no project write grants.
Malformed, uncovered, cyclic, over-budget or over-privileged drafts fail before execution.
Planner input/output are content-addressed artifacts with release and Context Manifest digests.
Fixture planner tests deterministic/no external account.
Optional model adapter failures structured and cannot silently fall back to another driver.
A Defect can produce bounded PlanPatchDraft while unchanged nodes and Evidence remain referenced.

known_limitations: This task adds bounded planner adapters and validation; it does not make model-generated PlanDraft execution automatic without PlannerOutputValidator acceptance.
The local reference implementation records content-addressed planner artifacts in memory/manifest form; it is not a distributed ArtifactStore service.
AcceptancePlanner can produce structured acceptance drafts, but existing acceptance contract validation remains the authority for Claim/Gate semantics.
The producer does not mark TASK-0030 completed; independent verifier and EvidenceGate decide completion.
